title: Mechanical Engineering Technology, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Penn State Erie, The Behrend College -- confirmed via `ls Backend/degree_plans` that no University Park equivalent of this major exists in this repo at all (no MET-*.json, and Mechanical Engineering Technology, B.S. isn't offered as a standalone UP degree -- UP's closest neighbor is Electro-Mechanical Engineering Technology, EMET-2026.json, a different program with its own EMET-prefixed courses). Pattern B by definition (no UP plan to compare against). Built fresh as METBH (no existing UP code to suffix, so a fresh, non-colliding code was chosen following this session's 'BH' convention). Real 8-semester Suggested Academic Plan, 130 total credits, taken verbatim from the live 2026-27 Behrend bulletin page. 'Technical Elective (300/400-level)' (x2, Fourth Year Fall) and 'Business Elective' (Fourth Year Spring) have no enumerated course list on the fetched bulletin page -- modeled as plain generic slots, honestly undocumented rather than fabricated. Gen Ed domain slots map onto the engine's real domain codes (GA/GH/GS/GHW single-domain, INTER-D for Inter-Domain); 'General Education (Exploratory)' has no matching real domain code in this engine's gen_ed_courses.json and is modeled as a plain generic Gen Ed slot. Real-prereq-chain fixes (same 'close the real gap' convention used throughout this repo): (1) CHEM 110 (Second Year Spring on the real bulletin) needs MATH 22, which needs MATH 21 -- neither is anywhere in this program's own MATH 41 -> 83 -> 210 -> 211 technical-math ladder; added MATH 21 + MATH 22 (Semester 1). (2) MET 111 and MET 213 both have a real catalog prereq of literally MATH 26 OR MATH 81 -- again neither appears in this program's own ladder; added MATH 81 (Semester 1, no real prereq of its own) to satisfy both, which also happens to satisfy MET 206's own (MATH 22 or MATH 82) alternate via the MATH 22 addition above.
